$comment: Performance budgets (#108), checked by `npm run budgets` in CI's budgets job. Raise a number only in a pull request that says why. Kernel and viewport baselines are a CI runner's own medians (2 to 3 times a laptop's); the check fails when a median is over its baseline by more than the tolerance.

bundle.$comment: KB gzipped, per chunk. The shell is the JavaScript index.html loads before first paint. totalJs went from 600 to 620 in #312: main was already at 601.9 after the text tool (#309) added fonts (glyphs, 50 KB, loaded only when you place text), alongside the path tracer (63 KB, loaded only for Render); the shell cap is what guards first paint. The shell went from 355 to 358 in #310: main was at 354.6, and dragging an arm by its tool point (#176) adds 1.2 KB of glue (the tool marker, the palette commands, the lock toggle) after its solver and drag moved to a lazy chunk. 358 to 361 in the clash check (#178): main was at 357.9, and the check adds 0.8 KB (its state, the overlap boxes, the command); its list and the kernel work load later. What's new (#319) adds 0.4 KB (the Help entry, the command and the hook); the notes, the seen list, the card and the dialog load later. totalJs went from 620 to 630 with named poses (#177): main was at 618.1 and they add 1.9 KB; everything past first paint loads on use. The shell went from 355 to 356 when dragging into components (#334) added 1.1 KB (drop onto a row in the tree, the Move into menu, the moves saved with the model) to a main at 354.5. totalJs went from 630 to 632 with components (#171): main was at about 629.3 after the shell trim (#332) split code into lazy chunks, and components add 1.0 KB (the nested browser, the active component, two icons). The shell went from 361 to 362 for dropping a sketch point on another point or a line to join it (#326): main was at 360.7, and the drag glue adds 0.4 KB (the snap while dragging, the coincident on drop); finding what it drops on loads with the sketch. The clash sweep (#179) adds 0.1 KB (its command and the panel props); the sweep, its state and the mesh test load later. totalJs went from 632 to 636 for the Parameters dialog with Model parameters: main was at about 631.6, and the dialog's chunk grows by about 2.5 KB (the steps' sizes, the filter, the comment column); it loads only when Parameters opens, and the shell moves 0.3 KB. Revolve's axis pick (#342) took the shell from 357 to 358 and totalJs from 639 to 642: main was at the shell cap, and the step's axis state, the axis button and help add about 0.5 KB at first paint after the picking itself (axisPick) and Construct's pick geometry (pickGeo) moved to lazy chunks; the rest loads with the Revolve tool. #320 took the shell to under 355 and the cap back to 355: the move gizmo (TransformControls), the catalogue's parts list, file import and the problem report's zip code now load after first paint. totalJs went from 637 to 639 for the tips card (#340): main was at about 636.8, and the card and its tips add 1.3 KB in their own chunk, loaded only when it shows; the shell moves 0.3 KB (the hook, the Help entry, the bulb icon). Pattern of features (copy a hole or stub onto the same body, round a construction axis, #343) took the shell from 358 to 359 and totalJs from 642 to 644: main was at about 357.2 and 641.1, and it adds 0.8 KB to the shell (copying ops with moves in the kernel document, the axis pick, the step picked on the timeline, the release note) and about 0.8 KB more in the kernel worker (the same document code) and the lazy Pattern bar. totalJs went from 644 to 650 for the build steps export (#348): main was at about 644.2, and the export adds 4.5 KB in its own chunk (the instructions, the offscreen step pictures, the zip), loaded only when you pick Build steps; the shell moves 0.3 KB (the menu entry and the command). The origin's X, Y and Z axes in the browser (#350) took the shell from 359 to 360: main was at about 358.5, and the three rows, their eyes, the axis colours and picking them for Pattern and Joint add about 0.5 KB of glue in the editor and the view. totalJs went from 650 to 652 for the tall feature panels: main was at about 649, and the panel (rows, pickers with an ×, tick boxes, folding) adds about 1.1 KB in a chunk that loads with the first tool; the shell does not move. totalJs went from 652 to 654 for faster extrude dragging: main was at about 651.0, and it adds about 1.1 KB (the ghost the drag draws, in the lazy arrow chunk, and the kernel worker keeping each body part way through its steps); the shell does not move. totalJs went from 656 to 659 for one panel for joints: main was at about 656, and the joint panel (both components with their snaps, the line-up and motion fields) and lining a component up on its joint (the move maths, in the shell's document code and again in the kernel worker) add about 1.7 KB; the tool and its panel load on first use, so the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 659 to 663 for topological naming (#47): main was at about 659, and naming faces and edges through each step adds about 2 KB to the kernel worker (and the Properties panel now loads in its own chunk, which took the shell from 359.9 to 358.3). totalJs went from 663 to 665 for the performance overlay (#42): main was at about 662.2 after rebuild progress (#364), and the overlay (its graph, the kernel step timings) now loads in its own chunk when turned on, which costs about 0.8 KB in all; the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 665 to 667 when main reached 665.2 after the alpha note (#368), sketches moving with their component (#369), round-edge joint snaps (#367) and the one-row timeline (#370) landed together, about 2 KB between them; the shell stays under its cap. Saved section analyses took the shell from 360 to 361: main was at about 359.3, and the Analysis folder, its eyes and menu, the Section tool editing a saved one and the document code for them add about 0.9 KB of glue in the browser and the view. totalJs went from 667 to 670 for snapping sketches to the model and the loupe that shows the view: main was at about 666.6, and they add about 2 KB in two chunks that load on first use (the model's snap targets when you first draw, the loupe's renderer when it first opens); the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 670 to 672 for the admin console: main was at about 669.6, and the page (every user and their models) adds about 1.5 KB to the pages chunk, which loads only off the editor; the shell moves 0.1 KB (the route and the menu entry). Fillets where faces pinch to a point (#377) and cleaner cuts on curved faces (#379) add about 0.9 KB to the kernel worker (the local round: the solid side of each face, the piece carved off and put back; the fuzzy boolean set-up) and their release notes, leaving main at about 671.3; the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 672 to 675 for joint snap points (#383, #384): main was at about 671.4, and finding a face's snap points and drawing them (round dots, the hovered one's axes) add about 2.3 KB to the joint tool's chunk, which loads on first use; the shell moves 0.1 KB (the pale hover face and its tokens). totalJs went from 675 to 677 for the joint loupe (#385, #386, #387): main was at about 673.7, and the loupe over crowded joint snaps, its close hint and the Settings switch add about 1.9 KB in the Joint tool's chunk; the shell went from 361 to 362 for it: main was at about 360.8, and the Settings switch and the sketch's check of it add about 0.3 KB at first paint (a lazy-loaded switch could not load offline from the cached app, so it stays in Settings). totalJs went from 677 to 679 for sharp corners behind rounds and bevels (#389) and the middle between two picks (#388): main was at about 675.6, and finding the cut-away corners, drawing them dashed and the Shift-click middle add about 1.3 KB to the Joint tool's chunk, which loads on first use; the view now gives each face's edge numbers (Engine.faceEdgeIds, about 0.1 KB at first paint). totalJs went from 679 to 682 for Send to kevsrobots: main was at about 678.5, and the dialog (pick or make a project, send, update) and the projects.kevsrobots.com client add about 2.6 KB in their own chunk, loaded only when you pick Send to kevsrobots; the shell moves 0.2 KB (the menu entry, the command and the link saved in the model). totalJs went from 682 to 685 for lining up hole patterns (#393) and snaps on imported meshes (#395): main was at about 681.8, and matching the holes and the mesh box snaps add about 1.4 KB to the Joint tool's chunk, which loads on first use; the shell moves 0.1 KB (Engine.bodyBox).

wasm.$comment: MB. OCCT is the opencascade.js build replicad ships (23 MB); the issue's 12 MB / 3.5 MB target needs a slimmer build of the same unmodified OCCT (#4, #50).

viewport.$comment: Since #204 the view fills the 1280 x 800 window (3.3 times the pixels it had), and the frame is 34 to 84 ms on runners depending on the runner (the kernel numbers swing by the same factor in the same runs). Baseline 90 leaves the same headroom over a fast runner as the kernel budgets have.

lighthouse.$comment: Desktop preset, Chromium with SwiftShader as CI runs it. Software WebGL compiles the view's shaders on the main thread (about 1 s of blocking time); with WebGL off the score is 100. The target is 0.85.
